**CNC-03 (DMG Mori NLX 2500, WS-2026-00006) lost the most time to breakdowns: 825 minutes — about 13¾ hours — over the last 90 days (2026-07-03 to 2026-10-01).**

Its three logged breakdown entries:
- 2026-09-06: 105 min — spindle vibration alarm, bearing suspected
- 2026-09-09: 150 min — stopped again on the same alarm; DMG Mori engineer called
- 2026-09-11: 570 min — full shift down for spindle bearing replacement; the log notes turning work was rerouted to CNC-04 and two OEM dates are now at risk

For comparison, the only other machine with logged breakdown time in the window is CNC-04 Jyoti DX 200 (WS-2026-00007) with 90 min (servo drive fault F-31, 2026-08-01) — so CNC-03 accounts for roughly 90% of all breakdown downtime.

Not visible to me: nothing was missing — this is from the downtime log directly, and no job cards or engineering changes were tied to these entries.
